title: Increasing the Height of Lighthouse tower from +15m Level to +21m Level to enhance the visibility at Olakuda Lighthouse, Rameswaram, under Chennai Directorate.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate contract) to raise the lighthouse tower at Olakuda Lighthouse, Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, from the +15 m to the +21 m level to improve visibility, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Olakuda Lighthouse, Rameswaram
sites.work: Increase tower height from +15 m level to +21 m level

scope.item: Increasing the Height of Lighthouse tower from +15m Level to +21m Level to enhance the visibility

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; validity stated as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate; tender fee amount not printed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost; only fully completed works with completion certificate; value enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works: construction of lighthouse/any tall structure/high-rise building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC high raised structure/RCC work, and repairs and civil maintenance of buildings
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost over last 3 consecutive financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), affidavit of not being blacklisted
List of gazetted and non-gazetted relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI); documents per Section VI
